title: metadata-protocol: the boot's metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved line counts a served .custom flow override and tells the operator to delete it
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① class (a) out-of-scope finding from the #28717 dev (os-dev-report `6562183858`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, carrier: none). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: every `loadMetaFromDb` boot of a store that holds a declared `<base>.custom` flow override. Since #28412 (PR #28693), that row is served and armed in place of the base's flow.

## What happens

The boot prints `[Protocol] [metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved]` (`reportSealedOverlayRows`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-sealed-overlay-report.ts`, called from `protocol.ts` around L29500). It counts the declared override row alongside a legacy package-less row: "flow×2 … No read serves them — the package's own definition is served … re-express it as a new item under a new name … then delete the stored row". The override IS served, so this line tells the operator to delete the live customization. That is a destructive remedy aimed at a working row. It was measured in `packages/services/service-automation/.../flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts` (PR #28770).

## Wanted

1. The sealed-overlay census stops counting a row that the served-override rule serves. The judgement is the existing `isServedOverrideRowOf` on the row's column binding (`storedRowBindingOf` / `package_id`), never a body `_packageId`. ⛔ No second predicate.
2. A truly unserved row, such as the legacy package-less row #28717 leaves shadowed, is still reported with its remedies.
3. Tests: a boot holding only the declared override prints no `metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved` line for it. A boot holding the override plus a legacy row reports the legacy row alone (count 1). Ablation.

## Triage: p2 · `bug` · `domain:server`

Ruling-ref: the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」 (2026-11-01). Graded p2 rather than p3 because the line prescribes deleting a live, armed customization. An operator who follows it silently reverts the tenant to the base flow. Nothing is wrong on the wire, so it is not p1.

Declarations expected: `Clause-②: no` (a log line only; no served value changes), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch.

Dedupe: searched `metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved`, `sealed overlay unserved declared override`; nothing open.

Links back: #28717, PR #28770, #28412, PR #28693, ADR-0131 D6, ADR-0146 D2
